text.p: Greek construction firm Proodeftiki will propose a three-for-10 bonus issue at the forthcoming annual general assembly, it said on Wednesday.
"The management will propose to shareholders a three-for-10 scrip issue resulting from a capitalisation of reserves," it said.
Proodeftiki said it would distribute a dividend per share of 70 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 50 a year earlier.
The uncompleted portion of its order book currently stands at 38.7 billion drachmas, it said.
The company is awaiting the outcome of tenders for infrastructure works budgeted at 50 billion drachmas. It has been short-listed for projects valued at 30.5 billion, it said.
Pretax earnings rose 15.9 percent to 1.512 billion drachmas in 1996 on turnover growth of 22.5 percent to 7.9 billion.
Proodeftiki closed down 35 drachmas at 1,945 on Wednesday. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
